text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne higher on firmer CBOT soycomplex calls as funds expected to either buy back the 5,000 July contracts they are short or buy July-Nov, traders said. United Grain Growers to issue its second seeding estimates report at 1400 CDT Wednesday with bulls looking for a low acreage forecast. Trade talk focused more on dryness concerns in southwest Manitoba. July WCE futures crush margin fell to -12.99 Tuesday from -9.55 Monday. The dollar was flat at C$1.3862 versus the U.S. dollar, fell to 80.04 Japanese Yen, fell to 1.2370 Marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 up on commercial short covering with hedges in new crop. European crushers may buy July despite short delivery time.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls as Alberta Wheat Pool expected to sell the July-Oct spread, commission houses expected to sell any gains in barley.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on higher CBOT wheat and corn calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
